summary: Describes the design principles behind the Blocks eXtensible eXchange Protocol, BXXP, and more broadly how to design application protocols. It discusses common problems every new protocol must solve, such as framing, authentication, and multiplexing.

eli5.summary: It is a list of the things you must decide when inventing a new language for computers, such as how to start and stop a sentence.

questions: how to design an application protocol
